Native orchid species occurring in Greece are protected under Presidential Decree 67/1981 (national), Council Regulation (EC) No 338/97 (European Union), and CITES Appendix II (international). Wild harvesting of orchids (e.g. for salep production) has been documented as a pressure on certain populations. This designation is intended as a risk-reduction measure only and does not represent a formal conservation assessment.
